name: TutorGym
summary: A testbed that puts AI agents inside existing tutoring systems (CTAT, Apprentice Tutors, OATutor), as tutors compared with the system's own feedback or as students compared with human learning data, across 223 tutor domains.
made_by: Teachable AI Lab, Georgia Institute of Technology
cite: Weitekamp, D., Siddiqui, M. N., & MacLellan, C. J. (2025). TutorGym: A Testbed for Evaluating AI Agents as Tutors and Students. AIED 2025. https://doi.org/10.1007/978-3-031-98420-4_26

fits.how: Its comparisons with human learning data could show which known errors a simulated learner reproduces before it plays the learner in agent tests.

connect.note: Python code to clone and run yourself. It checks simulated learners, and no agent test uses one yet.
